description.skin: Pale with glowing blue lightning scarification along the spine and temples

personality.traits: Extremely hyperactive and alert. Talks fast, constantly scanning skies for barometric shifts. Can sense atmospheric charge before lightning strikes.
personality.ideals: Liberty. Disruption of rigid power grids. Mastering the storm.
personality.bonds: My focal antenna is my life. It has survived three direct lightning strikes. I will protect my ridge outpost at all costs.
personality.flaws: Completely unable to sit still in low-pressure zones. Prone to sparking when agitated. Tends to overcomplicate simple logistical routing.

characterData.notes: A rogue field operative and weather-weaver who weaponizes electrostatic potentials. Once a high-altitude researcher for Chronos Systems, Gale went rogue after a critical overload event fused their neural net with a prototype micro-barometer. Now guides deep-canopy rebel cells through volatile thermal storms, using a custom copper-wound field baton to redirect incoming shock discharges.

weapons.label: WEAPON_1
weapons.name: Cathode Discharger (+2 Baton)
weapons.special_properties: Focal conductor for kinetic static. Can expend charges to emit a 15ft electrical cone.

weapons.label: WEAPON_2
weapons.name: Pneumatic Dart Launcher
weapons.special_properties: Silent compressed air system. Ignores crosswind penalties.

weapons.label: WEAPON_3
weapons.name: Static Grenades
weapons.special_properties: Creates a 10ft EMP sphere on impact, disrupting mechanical sensors.

armor1.name: Insulated Faraday Suit
armor1.special_properties: Immunity to lightning/electric damage and storm weather hazards.

armor2.name: Light-foot Mag-Boots
armor2.special_properties: Allows walking on sheer metal surfaces and ignoring difficult swamp terrain.

contacts:
• Comm-Link Node 'Echo-4' — A rogue AI agent inhabiting an abandoned communications satellite, providing weather projections.
• The High-Altitude Glider Renegades — An acrobatic smuggling crew who transport Gale's supplies through high-level jet streams.
• Undergrid Resistance Cells — Urban saboteurs who pay Gale in copper coils, vacuum tubes, and premium battery cells.
fractions:
• Chronos Atmospheric Division — The monolithic corporation that created Gale's implants and hunts them to retrieve the prototype.
• The Cloud-Weavers Circle — A mystical guild of wind-priests who view Gale's technology-assisted weather-weaving as heresy.
• The Free Sky Coalition — A loose federation of pilots and weather-outlaws.
desires:
• Overloading the Chronos Power Grids — To trigger a chain-reaction power failure across the entire industrial sector.
• Tuning the Electrostatic Antenna — To establish a stable telepathic link with the storm-spirits of the upper atmosphere.
• Releasing the Silt-mists — To blanket the entire lowlands in static mist to cover an imminent refugee escape.
sacrifices:
• Safe Grounding — Fused nervous system means Gale can never touch uninsulated organic life without administering a mild shock.
• Corporate Career & Prestige — Abandoned high-paying researcher status at Chronos Systems to avoid weapons-testing on sentient mires.
• Left Ear Hearing — Lost entirely during a high-frequency atmospheric sound-barrier breach.
atonements:
• Grounding Static Overloads — Safely dispersing lightning strikes away from vulnerable agrarian wooden settlements.
• Free Battery Charging — Utilizing bio-electric generation to recharge local rebel radios and medical devices.
• Restoring local radio relays — Restoring free, unmonitored communication lines for low-sector civilian refugees.
familyHistory: Subject is the offspring of two Chronos Aerology division directors. Conceived and raised in low-gravity test chambers. Subject's sister remains in corporate custody as a lead designer. Potential leverage vector identified.

assetsEquipment.propertyList:
• Prototype Atmospheric Baton
• Fused neural telemetry rig (Internal)
• Modular hideout inside an old wind turbine
• Insulated cargo chest with spare vacuum tubes

manifestations: Intermittent eye twitching synced with nearby AC power hums. Spontaneous static discharges from fingers when excited.
operativeNotes: Subject's neural integration with the micro-barometer is irreversible. Unlike Charity Vaughn's wild organic magic, Gale's potential is a hybrid of cybernetic transduction and elemental storm attunement. Standard neural suppressors fail due to constant electrostatic discharge. Recommend immediate thermal containment if capture is ordered.
